header.name: AI in Finance
header.description: Finance has long been influenced by technological advancements, given the substantial volumes of data it produces, the profound impact on global financial ecosystems, and the intricate regulatory framework it operates within. As artificial intelligence continues to reshape the financial sector—from retail banking and investment to lending, payments, and compliance—it is crucial for technical students to gain a solid grounding in financial principles. This course will explore these areas, enriched by contributions from industry experts.
prerequisites_desirable: Any one of the courses Money and Banking, Foundations of Finance, Valuation and Portfolio Management, Intro to FinTech

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Understand AI foundations (ML, NLP, CV, Forecasting) in financial contexts

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Apply AI models to different financial sub-industries

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Design AI-driven workflows for fraud detection, credit scoring, and risk management

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Evaluate regulatory, ethical and governance challenges in AI-driven finance

outcomes.label: CO5
outcomes.raw_text: Build prototype AI solutions using real-world financial datasets

lecture_topics: Introduction to AI in Finance: Industry Landscape & Trends
